summary: PBF Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary PBF Holding Company LLC and PBF Finance Corporation priced a $500 million aggregate principal amount of 7.25% senior unsecured notes due 2034 in a private offering, expected to close May 28, 2026. Net proceeds plus available cash will redeem outstanding 6.00% Senior Notes due 2028. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation event. No stock price or premium was involved. The filing reports a standard capital markets transaction.
